title: Gerente Regional de Investigações Antifalsificação (América)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Sobre a Função

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Regional de Investigações Antifalsificação para integrar nossa equipe global de Group Security. A posição reporta-se ao(à) Líder Global de Antifalsificação (ACF) e tem como objetivo liderar a estratégia regional de combate à falsificação, protegendo nossa marca, nossos consumidores e nossa propriedade intelectual.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam atuar em um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e com impacto real nos negócios, trabalhando em parceria com equipes internas, autoridades e parceiros externos em diferentes países da região.

Base: Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo

Principais Responsabilidades

Liderança Estratégica

  • Colaborar com áreas internas como negócios, jurídico, assuntos corporativos e comunicação
  • Construir e manter parcerias com autoridades, entidades do setor e stakeholders estratégicos
  • Gerenciar fornecedores de serviços de investigação, promovendo eficiência, inovação e uso responsável do orçamento
  • Definir indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e acompanhar resultados
  • Comunicar avanços e insights de forma clara à liderança e às partes interessadas


Execução Operacional

  • Identificar mercados, produtos e riscos prioritários na região
  • Implementar estratégias regionais de antifalsificação alinhadas aos objetivos globais
  • Supervisionar investigações online e offline realizadas por parceiros externos
  • Desenvolver inteligência sobre tendências, rotas e novos métodos de falsificação
  • Atuar em conjunto com autoridades, alfândega e órgãos reguladores em ações de enforcement
  • Garantir conformidade com legislações internacionais de propriedade intelectual
  • Apoiar iniciativas legais relacionadas à falsificação
  • Gerenciar o orçamento regional do programa de antifalsificação
  • Avaliar resultados e ajustar estratégias quando necessário
  • Trabalhar com equipes de embalagem e negócio na adoção de tecnologias de autenticação de produtos


Engajamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores externos de investigação
  • Desenvolver treinamentos regionais sobre riscos e prevenção à falsificação
  • Representar a Haleon em fóruns, eventos e grupos de trabalho do setor
  • Atuar como referência técnica para stakeholders internos na região


Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida (mín. 5 anos) em investigações, proteção de marca, antifalsificação ou enforcement de propriedade intelectual
  • Vivência com autoridades, alfândega e equipes jurídicas em contextos internacionais ou regionais
  • Experiência na gestão de investigações complexas e fornecedores externos
  • Conhecimento em leis de propriedade intelectual e tendências de falsificação
  • Certificações na área são um diferencial
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita
  • Ética, resiliência e senso de responsabilidade
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório)


Competências Essenciais

  • Autonomia, organização e tomada de decisão responsável
  • Capacidade de atuar tanto de forma estratégica quanto prática
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders e equipes diversas
  • Experiência em gestão de orçamento e fornecedores
  • Mentalidade orientada a risco, aprendizado contínuo e melhoria constante
  • Capacidade de colaborar com pessoas de diferentes culturas, países e realidades


About The Role

As part of a global team within Group Security, the Anti-Counterfeit Regional Investigations Manager reports to the Global Lead for Anti-Counterfeiting (ACF). The main function of the role is to tactically develop and implement the ACF strategy, manage and supervise ACF Program investigations and activities in the designated geographic region to include country specific plans. Responsibilities include intelligence assessment, case selection, the management and oversight of anti-counterfeit investigations (online and offline), proactive investigation case management, to include the development and implementation of innovative approaches and investigative strategies to meet business needs.

The manager will collaborate with internal business stakeholders, law enforcement, legal teams, and external partners to drive enforcement actions and strategic initiatives. The role ensures the protection of the company’s intellectual property, brand integrity, and consumer trust by identifying, investigating, and mitigating counterfeit activities.

Location: Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop operational relationships with key internal stakeholders including business, legal, corporate affairs, and corporate communications
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with law enforcement agencies, industry bodies, regulatory authorities, and peer organizations
  • Build and maintain strategic and tactical investigation service supplier relationships, promoting innovation, responsiveness, cost optimization, return on investment (ROI), and continuous improvement
  • Develop KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness and return on investment (ROI)
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership and stakeholders


Operational Execution

  • Conduct risk assessments to identify high-risk markets and products
  • Develop and implement regional anti-counterfeit strategies aligned with global brand protection goals
  • Provide instruction and guidance to external investigation suppliers based on the strategic direction set by the Global Program Lead
  • Provide effective case management oversight and direction by working with external investigation suppliers to ensure investigations are conducted and reported efficiently and in accordance with Haleon’s ACF Program Strategy
  • Develop intelligence strategies to identify and monitor counterfeiting trends
  • Oversee regional monitoring of counterfeit activities across online and offline channels
  • Implement a regional customs strategy to identify key strategic ports and counterfeiting routes, product authentication training opportunities, and intelligence dissemination practices
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, customs, regulatory bodies, and industry coalitions to pursue and, when appropriate attend, enforcement actions
  • Ensure ACF Program compliance with international IP laws and regulations
  • Support litigation efforts related to counterfeit activities
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of counterfeit trends and regulatory changes
  • Manage the regional anti-counterfeit program budget, ensuring effective forecasting, spend control, and ROI
  • Monitor and evaluate enforcement outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly
  • Identify and report counterfeiting developments and techniques which undermine product security
  • Work with packaging design and business teams to evaluate and implement product authentication technologies (e.g., serialization, digital watermarking, blockchain).


Stakeholder Engagement and Training

  • Manage relationships with external investigation service suppliers
  • Develop regional training programs to educate stakeholders on counterfeiting risks and mitigation opportunities
  • Represent Haleon at regional industry forums, conferences and working groups to share intelligence, benchmark practices, and influence standards
  • As a subject matter expert, support a regional network of non-ACF champions embedded across business units and functions


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in law enforcement investigations, brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, or IP enforcement
  • Experience of working with law enforcement, customs, and legal teams across international jurisdictions
  • Proven experience in investigating and managing complex proactive investigations and enforcements
  • Demonstrated success in managing third-party investigation service suppliers and operational budgets
  • Professional certification such as Interpol Intellectual Property (IP) Crime College or recognized university anti-counterfeit or intellectual property program accreditation strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of IP laws, counterfeit trends, and enforcement mechanisms
  • Exceptional written/oral communication
  • High ethical standards, discretion, and resilience under pressure


Core Competencies

  • Self-motivated and able to act independently and responsibly demonstrating sound and ethical judgment
  • Ability, at both a strategic and tactical level, to identify and manage ACF related issues and customize, implement, and execute solutions
  • Strong commercial acumen and budget/vendor management experience
  • Risk-based thinking and continuous improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Demonstrate ability to work with a wide range of individuals from diverse backgrounds, countries of origin, and at varying levels within the corporate structure


Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Reservoir Engineer - entry-level
description:
Job Summary

The Reservoir Engineer is responsible for assisting in delivery of safe, efficient, and reliable products and services to our customers. The job consults with operations groups as needed to support the area of expertise and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement of product and service delivery and formally communicates findings. The Reservoir Engineer actively participates in promoting new technology and services offerings and supports the PL in risk management and applying lessons learned to improve job design and execution as related to the area of expertise. They provide real-time support to operations as required.

Additional Responsibilities
  • Provide technical support in the area of expertise throughout the Sales and Product and Service Delivery process.
  • Assist as required with the development of technical job designs for PLs.
  • Assist with identifying areas where new and cost effective techniques can be applied.
  • Explore opportunities for value-added products and services.
  • Consult with Design/Technical Engineer role as required to optimize the technical design.
  • Assist in real-time incident response, recovery, and investigation as related to the area of expertise.
  • Assist in evaluating technical viability and overall appraisal of tenders as related to the area of expertise.
  • Remain current on new technologies.
  • Maintain customer visibility through active participation in professional society activities and calls for papers.
  • Understand the competition’s technical offering.
  • Participate in external technical societies and communities.
  • Contribute, write and review technical publications.
  • Engage with local universities, Customer institutes and research organizations.
Requirements
  • Academic Background: A bachelor's or master's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Reservoir Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics or related field is expected.
  • Language: Intermediate/advanced English
  • Practical Experience: Previous experience in internships, research projects, or working in the oil and gas industry, especially in roles related to reservoir engineering and numerical simulation, would be highly valued.
  • Experience in Numerical Simulation: Proven experience in numerical simulation of reservoirs using specialized software such as Eclipse, Petrel or similar. This includes the ability to model the behavior of fluids in oil and gas reservoirs, simulate fluid flow in different scenarios, and interpret the results.
  • Knowledge of Programming Language: Strong proficiency in programming language, especially Python. This includes the ability to write scripts and programs to automate tasks, manipulate data, create analysis and visualization tools, and integrate different parts of the simulation workflow.
  • Knowledge in Geology and Reservoir Engineering: Solid understanding of the concepts of petroleum geology, reservoir engineering and oil recovery processes. This includes the ability to interpret geological and engineering data to create accurate reservoir models.
  • New energies and sustainability: desirable knowledge of numerical simulation applied to new energies and sustainability, such as carbon capture and storage.
Soft Skills
  • Analytical and Problem Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex problems related to reservoir engineering, identify effective solutions and implement them efficiently.
  • Communication and Teamwork: Verbal and written communication skills are crucial for communicating results, collaborating with teammates and presenting technical information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Given the dynamic nature of the oil and gas industry and constant technological changes, it is important that the candidate demonstrates adaptability and willingness to continually learn new techniques and technologies.

title: Global Head of GSI Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We have created a new senior leadership role, Head of Global System Integrator (GSI) Alliances, to lead our business development and partnership with these important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we are expanding into the enterprise market where GSIs provide significant operational and tactical capacity. We have had good success with GSIs that are delivering next‑generation private cloud, container, and public cloud solutions built with Canonical Ubuntu, and are looking to expand our investment in these alliances.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Global Head of GSI Alliances will lead a team of representatives and develop that strategic go‑to‑market strength for Canonical. You will work closely with GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open‑source solutions at scale for their enterprise customers. In this role you will be responsible for ensuring that our solutions are used or embedded at the core of GSI digital transformation platforms.

Our GSI team builds trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increases Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizes the partnership and leads all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. The Global Head of GSI Alliances will own the strategy, sell‑to, sell‑through and sell‑with motions with all GSI partners, as well as promotion of our GSI‑related activities – from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and GSI‑related events (including Canonical's yearly GSI executive summit).

Location: Our company largely works from home; this role can be based in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails
  • Own and drive GSI partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical
  • Lead and evolve a team towards accelerated revenue growth with GSI
  • Build strategic relationships with partners at executive levels
  • Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organization
What we are looking for in you
  • Experience in alliance and indirect sales management roles
  • Experience in the GSI sector
  • Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue and margins
  • Proven leadership and presentation skills
  • Insight into open source, Ubuntu and Canonical's competition and opportunities
  • Track record of data‑driven decision‑making
  • An autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality
What we offer colleagues
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Supervisão de Comunicação e Experiência da Marca
description:
Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Planejar, estruturar e executar réguas de comunicação para campanhas de incentivo, garantindo consistência, frequência e engajamento ao longo de toda a jornada;
  • Liderar e acompanhar campanhas de incentivo, desde o conceito até a entrega final, assegurando alinhamento com o posicionamento da marca;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar a experiência da marca em todos os pontos de contato com o público interno e parceiros;
  • Realizar negociação e gestão de parcerias estratégicas (fornecedores, agências e stakeholders internos);
  • Supervisionar a operação da loja corporativa MAG Presente, incluindo curadoria, logística, performance e experiência do usuário;
  • Gerenciar projetos simultâneos, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, orçamento e qualidade das entregas;
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time, promovendo organização, autonomia e alta performance;
  • Atuar como elo entre áreas internas (comercial, comunicação, operações) e parceiros externos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e propor melhorias contínuas nas iniciativas de experiência e engajamento.
Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em marketing, experiência de marca, trade marketing ou campanhas de incentivo.
  • Vivência com réguas de comunicação (CRM, jornadas, campanhas multicanal).
  • Experiência em negociação com fornecedores e gestão de parcerias.
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de projetos e pessoas.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de influência.

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Influenciar times especialistas que atuam em múltiplos produtos, sem gestão direta. Garantir clareza estratégica e velocidade de execução em produtos de alta exposição e relevância. Manter os produtos atualizados frente às rápidas transformações do mercado de entretenimento digital;

description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ✈️

A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG) !

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Somos um dos maiores hubs da dnata no mundo, atuando em 26 aeroportos , de norte a sul do país, e em mais de 140 aeroportos em todo o planeta. Sempre em terra, garantindo que cada atendimento aconteça com segurança, responsabilidade e excelência .

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams
  • Close collaboration with the VP of Science
  • Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English
Start Date: Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations
  • Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader.
  • Design and execute scalable ERW deployment operations in Brazil.
  • Translate climate goals into operational strategies.
  • Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance.
Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership
  • Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders.
  • Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment
  • Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows.
  • Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment.
  • Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact.
Team & Culture Building
  • Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture.
  • Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and impact.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads.
Ideal Candidate Profile

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts.
  • Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency.
  • Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership.
  • Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture.
  • Deep network in Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic partnerships in Brazil.
  • Experience developing and scaling agricultural tech.
Our Values
  • Trust: Promote transparency and kindness.
  • Drive: Take action with urgency and purpose.
  • Impact: Aim to make a meaningful global difference.
Benefits

  • Share options to foster ownership.
  • Home office budget, hybrid remote work (around São Paulo).
  • Personal development and language allowances.
  • 40 days of annual leave.
  • Autonomy to innovate and impact.
  • Bi-annual team offsites in Brazil.

title: Software Engineer - Go - Container Images
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Canonical is building a new generation of Ubuntu‑based container images to simplify open‑source application deployment across the world. In this role, you’ll be developing the tools and technology for building and maintaining this new generation of container images. You’ll be working with multiple teams, both inside and outside Canonical, to ensure we deliver container images with the highest quality whilst maintaining a seamless Ubuntu user experience. You will also be highly involved in the implementation and maintenance of the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery automation around these container images, for which you are expected to demonstrate deep insights into container‑based DevOps.

You will be contributing to fast‑moving products like Rocks (OCI images) and Chisel, and thus have the chance to help steer and consolidate this new team. You’ll gain experience with numerous container technologies and participate in exciting and exploratory tasks, where your feedback will be critical for the decision‑making process. As an engineer, your seniority will be based on your software development background and ability to lead junior team members.

Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical. title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.
Customer Storytelling & Consulting
  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.

Environment Implementation

AI-Driven Efficiency
  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.
Documentation & Ticket Writing
  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.
Who You Are
  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.

  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.
Why Join TestBox
  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.

Sobre o Banco de Talentos

A BigDataCorp tem a missão de democratizar o acesso aos dados. Nós temos sede por crescimento e inovação, e queremos ser a maior datatechplataforma de dados do mundo. Estamos sempre em evolução e crescimento, por isso, novas posições dentro da BigDataCorp são constantemente necessárias.

Criamos o Banco de Talentos para acelerar o processo de recrutamento e seleção, trazendo maior transparência para os candidatos, e mais agilidade para o time interno trabalhando com este processo. Se você curtiu e se identificou com a nossa empresa, inscreva-se em nosso Banco de Talentos! Seja a primeira pessoa a ser considerada para oportunidades na BDC.

Sobre a área e a vaga

O time de Infraestrutura é responsável por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa. Da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem à segurança da informação. Estamos à procura de um Especialista DevOps apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar a nossa equipe de TI. Se você é especialista em implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a entrega contínua de software e eficiência operacional, queremos te conhecer.

  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes de infraestrutura na AWS, com foco em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;

Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas) – Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Gas Corp & Commercial Legal Practice provides legal support to the company’s upstream unconventional gas business, including drilling, production, processing and day-to-day operations as well as related joint ventures and subsidiaries.

As Senior Counsel, your primary role is to provide comprehensive corporate and commercial legal services, working closely with internal stakeholders and coordinating with specialist legal teams in areas such as tax, intellectual property (IP), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and dispute resolution. The role will require collaboration with external legal counsel as needed.

Key Responsibilities
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and legal agreements.
  • Provide strategic legal advice to internal clients, identifying and mitigating potential legal risks while supporting business objectives.
  • Lead or support multidisciplinary legal and commercial projects, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
  • Advise on claims management and dispute resolution processes.
  • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.
Required Qualifications
  • A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization.
  • Demonstrated in-depth understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly unconventional gas operations.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements and deliver clear, practical legal advice to business clients.
  • Strong leadership and mentorship experience, with the ability to guide junior legal professionals.
  • Prior experience serving as Corporate Secretary to a Board of Directors is highly desirable.

title: Agente de Saneamento - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres
description:
Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio.

Descrição Resumida do Cargo

O/a Supervisor/a Operacional será responsável por atuar no acompanhamento e na organização das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento, dos prazos e dos procedimentos operacionais. A função é essencial para assegurar a qualidade da execução, o suporte à equipe operacional e o alinhamento das ações às diretrizes institucionais.

Nossa cultura e o cuidado com a nossa gente nos transporta para posicionamentos ainda mais diversos, equitativos e inclusivos. O resultado de toda nossa dedicação é refletido em pesquisas de clima realizadas com nossos colaboradores. Em 2022, a Log-In conquistou, pelo segundo ano consecutivo, o selo de Great Place to Work® (GPTW). No mesmo ano, entramos no Ranking GPTW de melhores empresas para trabalhar do Espírito Santo e, em 2023, no Ranking de melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio de Janeiro.

Uma conquista que nos orgulha e nos incentiva a continuar fazendo de tudo para ser um lugar cada vez melhor para as pessoas.

Nossa jornada também é marcada pela inovação, responsabilidade e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time. Será um prazer ter você aqui com a gente!

  • 4) Verificar as condições de operação, pelo menos uma vez por quarto ou divisão, dos sistemas fora da praça de máquinas (ar condicionado, frigoríficas, engaxetamento de bucha, máquina do leme etc.) quando o Oficial de Serviço assim determinar.

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization.

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.

Key Responsibilities

As successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs.
  • Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification.
  • Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering.
  • Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring.
  • Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno-economic evaluations.
  • Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment.
  • You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling refinery’s utilities.
  • You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation
  • You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have in-depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities.
  • You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems.
  • You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics.
  • You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management.
Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes.

O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis.

A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo.

A qualidade é garantida através de um investimento constante em tecnologia, desde a matéria-prima ao maquinário. Toda essa estrutura só é possível graças ao potencial humano: são mais de 6.000 colaboradores, 1.000 franqueados e 5.000 consultores em todo o Brasil.

title: Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine
description:
Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities
  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.
Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications
  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.
Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements
  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

Note: This job description contains general information and is not an exhaustive listing of duties and responsibilities. EEO statements and other legally required notices remain in effect.

description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information

Nosso propósito é transformar a sociedade por meio da nossa energia, levando desenvolvimento e bem-estar por onde passamos todos os dias. E fazer parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros, por mais de um século, só reforça a nossa contribuição com o crescimento econômico e social do país.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Compreender como os diferentes riscos cibernéticos podem afetar as operações da Globo, priorizando os esforços para proteger os aspectos mais vitais do negócio e minimizar possíveis interrupções, violações de dados, não conformidade, penalidades financeiras ou impactos na marca e/ou reputação;
  • Avaliar o impacto potencial dos riscos de segurança cibernética nos processos e funções críticas do negócio;
  • Avaliar a relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação as possíveis perdas, ponderando as despesas com a implementação de controles de segurança em relação ao impacto financeiro e operacional de um incidente de segurança, otimizando a alocação de recursos para alcançar a máxima eficiência na redução de risco;
  • Alinhar a gestão de riscos cibernéticos com os objetivos do negócio, compreendendo os objetivos estratégicos e garantindo que as medidas de segurança cibernética sejam integradas de forma harmoniosa;
  • Coordenar a identificação e classificação dos riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e os impactos desses riscos;
  • Coordenar a coleta de dados de avaliação de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e realizar avaliações de riscos de segurança cibernética para terceiros críticos, conforme necessário;
  • Implementar e evoluir com o sistema de monitoramento e gerenciamento de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros, conforme definido nos contratos com terceiros e de acordo com Política de Segurança da Informação para Fornecedores;
  • Construir planos de remediação, colaborando com as demais lideranças da empresa para alcançar um equilíbrio entre os requisitos de segurança e a necessidade de agilidade, inovação e crescimento do negócio, assegurando que as ferramentas de segurança ou outros controles compensatórios sugeridos reduzam o risco identificado para um nível aceitável;
  • Fornecer treinamento/orientação às partes interessadas em toda a Globo para promover uma forte cultura de conscientização sobre riscos.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Bacharelado em: Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em auditoria de TI, gestão de riscos corporativos (ERM) ou gestão de riscos cibernéticos;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em identificar e avaliar riscos para os negócios da organização, estruturas de gestão de riscos e estruturas de gestão de segurança da informação, com foco na priorização de esforços para proteger aspectos vitais e minimizar interrupções;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos dos padrões de segurança cibernética, incluindo, mas não se limitando ISO 27005, OpenFAIR, NIST RMF, IRAM, TOGAF, NIST CSF e ISO/IEC 27001;
  • Histórico comprovado na realização de Análises de Custo-Benefício de Medidas de Segurança, incluindo a avaliação da relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação a potenciais perdas comerciais;
  • Experiência com princípios e práticas de segurança cibernética, incluindo gerenciamento de riscos, controles de segurança e continuidade de negócios, entre eles a ISO 22301, Práticas Profissionais do Disaster Recovery Institute (DRI) e a elaboração de Análise de Impacto no Negócio (BIA);
  • Experiência comprovada na integração da gestão de riscos de segurança cibernética com a estratégia geral de negócios, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Experiência com auditorias de conformidade, segurança e planos de mitigação de riscos;
  • Amplo conhecimento dos conceitos de gestão de riscos e governança de segurança cibernética de terceiros;
  • Experiência na avaliação de riscos de terceiros, condução e resposta a procedimentos de due dilligence e na criação de questionários para avaliação de riscos cibernético de terceiros para terceiros empresariais;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar efetivamente os outros, modificando opiniões, planos ou comportamentos de forma estruturada e eficiente com base nos dados e fatos analisados;
  • Domínio de técnicas de apresentação, possibilitando a construção de narrativas e histórias através de apresentações;
  • Experiência em influenciar terceiros e gerenciar relacionamentos com terceiros;
  • Conhecimento de métodos analíticos e proficiência em análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias e ferramentas (por exemplo: serviços de classificação financeira, serviços de classificação de segurança, plataformas integradas de gerenciamento de risco, plataformas de gerenciamento de risco de terceiros, etc.) que auxiliarão na avaliação do risco financeiro e operacional associado a fornecedores atuais e potenciais.
Conhecimentos que te destacam
  • Certificações de gestão de riscos e segurança da informação como: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA) ou Open FAIR Part-1.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

description:
Senior Civil Engineer Designer Knight Piésold and Co. • Rio de Janeiro, BR

We have an opening available for a Senior Civil Engineer Designer in our Belo Horizonte, Brazil office.

Do you want to make a difference in the world? Are you interested in applying your skills, talents, and education to work at a company that values people and excellence; has a long history of success, and is valued by repeat clients in an industry that makes our quality of life better? Do you want to be part of a team that will inspire you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? If you said yes to these questions, then read on to learn more about Knight Piésold and the opportunities we have open.

You will build on your talents through knowledge-sharing culture, working across borders and collaborating with top professionals in the industry.

The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Civil Engineer Designer responsible for the drafting of drawings and computer aided design of projects and/or project elements (largely earthworks related), taking projects from conceptual designs through refined 3D CAD models, and then to the production of detailed design drawings. Additional duties will include the calculation of various quantities from 3D models and aiding others in refining and drafting their designs.

Responsibilities
  • Under minimal supervision, completes complex design tasks, CAD assignments, and preparation of designs for visualizations and presentations.
  • Analyze and provide recommendations; make decisions requiring independent judgement.
  • Proficient knowledge of relevant engineering and scientific theory, principles and practices.
  • Maintains outstanding relationships with internal/external clients, fostering a collaborative environment within project development.
  • Provides technical guidance and assists with training of junior technicians.
  • Provides input/recommendations to develop improved CAD systems and procedures.
  • Consistently follows KP policies and procedures and demonstrates consistent application.Responsible for successful delivery of work on time and on budget.
Ideal Candidate will have
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in civil engineering or related fields.
  • Registered as a Professional Engineer.
  • 10+ years of work experience related to mining, hydropower, and/or infrastructure project development with a strong background in geotechnical analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk infrastructure design tools (e.g., Civil 3D, InfraWorks), and experience with GIS, hydraulic, hydrotechnical, and geotechnical software.
  • Proven experience and ability for project/client management.
  • Excellent communication skills and a demonstrated capability to work cooperatively within multidisciplinary teams.
